title: Privileged role granted
description: A successful assignment of a recognized broad administrative role. Validate change context before response.

title: Credential created after privilege grant
description: The same provider, account, and actor performed a privileged grant followed by credential creation within ten minutes.

title: Audit collection disrupted
description: A successful stop, deletion of an audit trail, diagnostic setting, or logging sink. Verify intended routing and change authorization.

title: Privilege grant followed by audit disruption
description: A recognized broad role grant followed by logging disruption by the same provider, account, and actor within fifteen minutes.

title: Agent repeatedly denied tool access
description: At least five denied tool calls by the same agent in sixty seconds. Could indicate policy probing or an incorrectly configured agent.

title: Invalid or replayed approval
description: The gateway rejected an approval. Investigate expiration, mismatched arguments, or reuse. This signal alone does not distinguish those causes.
